title: Wardrobe and Blue Hour
author: Ines Halloran
blurb: Kestrel Joubert, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has spent ten years practicing the art of almost saying it. But when a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
